fixture.target: X99 recyclable AVD; exact serial requires Sol's issue-visible grant
fixture.user_state: dedicated non-premium test state; confirm the Home DiscountBadge before each case
fixture.first_home_interruption: Premium auto-opens about one second after Home for a non-premium user; dismiss with Android system Back without purchase before each case.
fixture.tap_timestamp_source: The verifier derives matching tap action timestamps from the same session's steps rows; positive requires exactly two and control exactly one. Tap timestamps are never typed as verifier inputs.
fixture.reset: Force-stop and cold-start before each independent case; each cold start resets show history; do not clear app data or cold-start between the positive case's two clicks.
fixture.interstitial_close: For each shown interstitial, close with its visible close control within 15 seconds of the first visible frame; record show and close timestamps from the recording; otherwise report NOT-RUN.
fixture.allow_log_timeout_race: The app's 15-second show wait starts when it calls show, not when the first frame is visible. If the allow line is absent after a close within 15 seconds, report that attempt NOT-RUN for the timeout race; do not count the missing line as a denial or a pass.
fixture.sigkill_logger_limit: SIGKILL can bypass the capture wrapper's EXIT trap. Confirm the recorded logger PID is gone before device release; if it remains, follow Sol's granted cleanup route and do not release the device yet.

second_click_timing.measure_from: t1: first exact show allowed log timestamp after dismissal
second_click_timing.measure_to: t2: second matching tap action timestamp derived from this session's steps rows after the single Android system Back action in step 3
second_click_timing.visible_duration: D: first ad's visible duration from first visible frame to close-control activation in the recording
second_click_timing.interval_basis: SDK show-history timing starts when shown, not dismissal; the second gate check follows the next ad load (up to 4 seconds); the 5-second margin includes that load and 1-second timestamp uncertainty; D accounts for the first ad's visible duration before t1.
second_click_timing.missed_window_result: NOT-RUN; do not tap after the derived window or count a late or absent denial as a pass

positive_case.missing_revenue_result: FAIL: revenue_event_missing; the revenue outcome is not a pass.
positive_case.gate_failure_result: FAIL: gate_allowed_inside_interval with two allow lines and no denial inside the verified timing window; record revenue_observation separately as present, missing, or malformed.
positive_case.hourly_cap_coverage: not covered; this case tests the 20-second minimum interval only

negative_control.goal_source: qualification/manifests/tinos_demo_gated_interstitial.che2016.v1.json:entry_point.case_goals.tinos-demo-first-click-negative-control; submit the complete goal string verbatim as the single CLI goal argument.
negative_control.false_assertion: The first Direct Message feature click must be denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED).
negative_control.tap_source: Exactly one matching tap action timestamp from this same session's steps rows; not a manually entered verifier input.
negative_control.missing_allow_result: NOT-RUN: the show-call timeout can race a close within 15 seconds of the first visible frame.
negative_control.intended_reason: The first click is allowed, the required revenue observation passes, and only the deliberately false denial assertion fails.
negative_control.reject_if_denial_present: Any show denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED) line makes the one-tap control invalid.
negative_control.event_time_validation: Map each device log epoch to the host epoch using capture metadata. Every recognized event's full clock-uncertainty interval must be inside the exact session's MIN(timestamp)..MAX(timestamp) step window and strictly after the first tap; every event must also be at or after the device-epoch logcat cursor.
negative_control.adapter: qualification/tools/tinos_demo_verdict_exit.py control mode; Tinos-specific testcase-side verdict-to-exit tool; not a runner change. Exit 1 with fail_assertion only when Artemis exit is 0, exact allow and revenue observations pass, no denial event exists, all counted timestamps pass the same-session window and first-tap checks, and the sole failed final assertion is the exact false assertion with same-session Checker and runner-bound final-capture identity. Exit 2 with NOT-RUN when the allow line is missing after the timeout-race case, or invalid_control for missing revenue, malformed or fill-failed logs, an unexpected denial, stale or mismatched capture, a plain pass, or another non-intended result. Never apply the Pocket Actual adapter unchanged.

execution.entry_point: Pinned Artemis direct CLI wrapped by testcase-side exact-serial log capture, standalone and collected in the foreground.

verdict_adapter.control_exit_1: valid intended negative control only: Artemis returned 0; exactly one matching feature tap exists in the session; exact allow and revenue observations passed; no denial event exists; timestamps pass session, cursor, and first-tap checks; exactly the specified false assertion failed; same-session Checker trace and final capture match
verdict_adapter.control_exit_2: NOT-RUN for a missing allow line; otherwise invalid_control for missing or invalid evidence, a fill failure, an unexpected denial, stale or mismatched capture, plain pass, or Artemis process failure
verdict_adapter.positive_exit_0: PASS only when the exact allow, revenue, and denial observations and the measured timing bound pass, with a same-session passing Checker trace and final capture
verdict_adapter.positive_exit_10: FAIL for a missing or malformed revenue or denial observation, or two allow lines and no denial inside the verified timing window (gate_allowed_inside_interval)
verdict_adapter.positive_exit_11: NOT-RUN for fill failure, missing allow, missed close deadline, or missed timing window
verdict_adapter.positive_exit_12: INVALID-EVIDENCE for malformed, stale, outside-session, mismatched, or incomplete evidence

log_capture_tool.start_cursor_source: adb -s <Sol-granted-exact-serial> shell date +%s, recorded in device epoch before the exact-serial logger starts and before Artemis begins the cold-start action

clock_mapping.host_samples: date +%s.%N immediately before and after the device clock command
clock_mapping.event_rule: Normalize device log epochs to host epoch and require the full uncertainty interval to fall inside the exact session window and after the first tap.

log_capture_tool.pid_policy: Record the adb logcat process ID; stop and wait for that exact PID on EXIT, INT, or TERM, including runner failure. SIGKILL can bypass the wrapper trap; confirm that the recorded logger PID is gone before device release and follow Sol's granted cleanup route if it remains.

reporting.interpretation: Require all listed positive events. An allow requires its exact allow log and matching revenue unit; a denial requires its exact gate log after the second tap within the measured 20-second test window. Two allow lines and no denial inside the verified window are FAIL: gate_allowed_inside_interval; outside the timing window is NOT-RUN before event-count classification. Fill failures are neither. Missing revenue never passes the revenue outcome. Keep the negative control fail_assertion separate from the positive result.
reporting.logger_release_requirement: The executor must confirm the recorded logger PID is gone after every outcome before Sol verifies device release; SIGKILL can bypass the wrapper trap.
